companyDescription: Custom AI silicon (XPU) + optical/electro-optical interconnect for hyperscalers — the custom-ASIC #2 behind Broadcom; Celestial AI photonics deal advancing
priceNote: Live $154.39 on Nov 11, 2026, down ~10% over 5 sessions and ~53% below its $329.88 52-week high (low $70.69). Hit by the Nov 5 AI-chip selloff. Q3 FY27 results are Dec 1 after the close (company-confirmed).
summary: MRVL reports Q3 FY2027 on Dec 1 (company press release Nov 6; call 1:30pm PT). Company EPS guide is $1.05–1.15 and consensus is ~$1.10 / $3.15B revenue. The stock has halved from its high in the AI-trade unwind, while consensus targets sit at ~$300–311 (43 analysts, Strong Buy). That is ~+95% upside, far past the 20% gate. Dispersion is wide: Cantor cut to $225 Neutral, Craig-Hallum is $380. The setup mirrors Dec 2024, when a custom-AI guide sent MRVL +23% in a day. The catalyst is 20 days out, outside the 14-day North Star window, so a backtest miss there is a horizon artifact. Core Base bias is +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a ~4–8 week post-earnings re-rating horizon, not a 14-day call. Size 3–5%.

catalysts.name: Q3 FY2027 earnings — custom XPU + optical guide
catalysts.description: Company-confirmed Dec 1, 2026 after the close (call 1:30pm PT). EPS guide $1.05–1.15; consensus ~$1.10 / $3.15B. The custom-silicon ramp and the Q4 guide are the swing factors.

risks: Wide target dispersion ($225–$450) signals real uncertainty about custom-silicon share vs Broadcom, plus customer concentration.
Beta: MRVL fell harder than peers in the Nov 5 selloff and would do so again on a hawkish Dec 9 FOMC.
Read-through risk: NVDA (Nov 17) reports first and sets the tone for AI capex before MRVL speaks.
Integration and dilution from acquisitions (Celestial AI; a reported Lumentum all-stock deal) could cloud the print.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI semis are the epicenter of the Nov 5 selloff (SOX -9–12% on midterm data-center-regulation fears) and are rate-sensitive long-duration equities; a 50bp December surprise would extend the de-rating.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — Dec 1 falls after the Nov 25 PCE and before the Dec 9 FOMC. A hot PCE would pressure the stock into the print.
